subject: 大民居
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. ONE isolated transparent sprite for a realistic historical Chinese town game. Early-to-mid Qing NORTH CHINA, anonymous Beijing/Shengjing/Jinan architectural concept, not a specific monument reconstruction. Match the attached Song asset ONLY for realistic material texture, fine detail density, restrained weathering, lighting and game sprite rendering; CHANGE architectural forms to Qing northern grey-brick, grey-tile and dark timber. Orthographic DIMETRIC, yaw45 elevation30, STRICT 2:1 ground plane, east ground axis screen lower-right slope +0.5 and north upper-right slope -0.5, parallel lines NO perspective convergence. South doorway faces screen lower-left. Draw a thin rectangular ground boundary, entire footprint with visible left, front and right corners, NO thick floating base. Keep the entire sprite and soft contact shadow inside generous 10% transparent margins. TRUE transparent RGBA background. Light from screen UPPER LEFT, short soft contact shadow lower-right. Grey fired brick, matte grey barrel tiles with straight sober ridges, northern hard-gable walls, dark brown wooden lattice windows, no Jiangnan whitewashed tourist style. No text, pseudo-writing, plaques, characters, people, flags, modern objects, sky, horizon, landscape, trees, water or road outside footprint, no saturated lighting, cartoon, plastic, borders or watermark. A larger single-storey five-bay northern brick house, sober hard-gable grey tile roof, substantial grey brick end walls, dark wood lattice windows and central recessed doorway with simple stone steps, small attached side room; not a courtyard compound. Footprint 7m east-west by6m north-south.
